title: Why V-Sync Can Make Controls Feel Slower
description:
V-Sync removes tearing by waiting for a display refresh boundary, but a narrowly missed deadline or deep frame queue can make fresh input wait. This short animation explains why the delay is not one fixed number and how refresh rate changes the size of each timing window.

Sources:
https://gpuopen.com/manuals/fidelityfx_sdk/techniques/frame-interpolation-swap-chain/
https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/direct3d12/swap-chains
https://developer.nvidia.com/blog/advanced-api-performance-swap-chains/
